difficulty_reason: Full execution of the stacky formula: choose a smooth surjection V -> U from a scheme, compose with f, apply the spaces-level dimension formula (its content is carried by the published Morphisms of Spaces lemma; the pool's transcription card of it was rejected as a bare pointer, the named-pointer rank is legitimate here since the external lemma is a proven result), expand both sides by definition through chosen representatives, base-change to Spec k and use the base-change invariance of relative dimension - with the identification V x_X Spec k ~ V x_U (U x_X Spec k) written out in the span - and assemble the final equality. No omissions.
